policy: Retain a local source copy of every WRDS extract to build the reusable research archive
required_receipt_fields: source library/table and release/update version when supplied; unknown otherwise
payloads: Lossless compressed source rows; source values and schema preserved
deduplication: Reuse a verified identical payload; retain each acquisition receipt
retirement: The sole retained WRDS source copy is protected from disposable-study cleanup
git: No licensed source rows or credentials in Git
research_use: Source inspection and reconciliation first; audited publication required before strategy use
